normalization_assumptions: Denominator ~1.5M US 501(c)(3) public charities (Chariot docs say ~1.4M US nonprofits, fetched); overlap between PayPal and Chariot enrolments assumed 30-60%; dollar share inferred from concentration, not measured.
source_title: Inference from the rail rows above
notes: By count: pre-enrolled on an open networked rail (PayPal Grant Payments ~200k confirmed in 2022, likely ~250k+ now; Chariot 100k+, heavily overlapping) ~= 250k-400k of ~1.5M = ~15-25% (central ~20%). Chariot's 1.4M 'reach' needs claim-at-receipt or check, so it is not pre-enrolled. By grant dollars: much higher because dollars concentrate in large charities (top 1,000 = 49% of itemised DAF dollars) that are most likely enrolled on several rails; Fidelity pays 67% of grants by EFT; inference ~55-75% of DAF grant dollars go to charities with at least one open-rail enrolment. No public source measures this directly.
